notes: «وزادا جميعا عن شعبة» continues the first route (Muhammad b. al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar), so its names are written inside that route; the tail is null
«في هذا الإسناد» closes the second route as a back reference (rule 1 style); «بمثل معناه» is wording
«قال سمعت أبا حازم يحدث» makes Abu Hazim the one heard (rule 5); the Companion is Abu Hurayra
